title: Internal Knowledge-Base Q&A
one_liner: Ask a policy question and get an answer that cites the file and chunk it came from, with retrieval done locally by MiniLM embeddings and a numpy cosine index, no hosted vector service.

steps.text: Internal knowledge base: the sidebar lists the indexed documents and their chunks
Use sample: how do I request a leave of absence?
Ask: the answer cites the file and chunk it came from
A second question: submitting a business expense
Every answer is grounded: no citation, no claim
